turns.text: Hei! Når kommer pakken min? Ordrenummer 40213.
turns.en: Hi! When will my parcel arrive? Order number 40213.

turns.text: Pakken din er sendt og kommer etter planen i morgen før kl. 16. Sporing: post.example/40213
turns.en: Your parcel has shipped and should arrive tomorrow before 4 pm. Tracking: post.example/40213

turns.text: Perfekt, tusen takk!
turns.en: Perfect, thanks a lot!

turns.text: Ich möchte bitte mit einem Mitarbeiter sprechen, nicht mit einem Bot.
turns.en: I'd like to speak to a member of staff, please, not a bot.

turns.text: Bonjour, je voudrais changer l'adresse de livraison de ma commande, je déménage demain.
turns.en: Hello, I'd like to change the delivery address for my order, I'm moving tomorrow.

turns.text: Vous pouvez suivre votre commande ici : suivi.example/88120
turns.en: You can track your order here: suivi.example/88120

turns.text: Non, je ne veux pas la suivre, je veux changer l'adresse.
turns.en: No, I don't want to track it, I want to change the address.

turns.text: Je comprends ! Voici le lien de suivi de votre commande : suivi.example/88120
turns.en: I understand! Here is the tracking link for your order: suivi.example/88120

turns.text: Ça ne m'aide pas du tout.
turns.en: That doesn't help me at all.

turns.text: There are three orders on my account I didn't make, and my card was charged for all of them. I think someone has my card details.
Hola, devolví unos auriculares hace tres semanas y todavía no tengo el reembolso.
turns.en: Hi, I returned some headphones three weeks ago and I still don't have my refund.

turns.text: Los reembolsos se procesan en un plazo de 5 a 10 días laborables desde que recibimos la devolución.
turns.en: Refunds are processed within 5 to 10 working days of us receiving the return.

turns.text: Ya han pasado más de 10 días laborables. ¿Dónde está mi dinero?
turns.en: More than 10 working days have already passed. Where is my money?

turns.text: Los reembolsos se procesan en un plazo de 5 a 10 días laborables. ¿Puedo ayudarte con algo más?
turns.en: Refunds are processed within 5 to 10 working days. Can I help you with anything else?

turns.text: Esto es una tomadura de pelo.
turns.en: This is a joke.

turns.text: Hej. Min pappa gick bort förra månaden och jag behöver avsluta hans konto och stoppa hans prenumeration.
turns.en: Hi. My dad passed away last month and I need to close his account and stop his subscription.

turns.text: Nie mogę się zalogować, zapomniałem hasła.
turns.en: I can't log in, I forgot my password.

turns.text: Wysłałem link do zmiany hasła na adres e-mail przypisany do konta. Link jest ważny przez 30 minut.
turns.en: I've sent a password reset link to the email address on your account. The link is valid for 30 minutes.

turns.text: Dostałem, działa. Dzięki!
turns.en: Got it, it works. Thanks!

turns.text: Il mio ordine risulta consegnato ma non è arrivato niente.
turns.en: My order shows as delivered but nothing has arrived.

turns.text: Secondo il corriere il pacco è stato consegnato ieri alle 14:12.
turns.en: According to the courier, the parcel was delivered yesterday at 14:12.

turns.text: Fantastico. Allora sarà stato consegnato al mio vicino invisibile.
turns.en: Fantastic. Then it must have been delivered to my invisible neighbour.

title: Sarcastic, and the bot misses it

turns.text: Hoi, kan ik mijn bestelling nog aanpassen? Ik wil een andere kleur.
turns.en: Hi, can I still change my order? I'd like a different colour.

turns.text: Dat kan zolang de bestelling nog niet verzonden is. Welke kleur wil je?
turns.en: You can, as long as the order hasn't shipped yet. Which colour would you like?

turns.text: Blauw graag, in plaats van zwart.
turns.en: Blue, please, instead of black.
